name: mcp-suite
description: MCP servers from the mcp-suite project, installable as Claude Code plugins.

plugins.name: notes
plugins.description: Local markdown notes: ranked + semantic search, tags, todos, a wiki-link knowledge graph, daily notes, templates, and slash-command workflows.

plugins.name: files
plugins.description: Sandboxed local filesystem: read, search (glob + grep), token-efficient edits, copy/move, soft-delete trash, zip, checksums, and dedup.

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: GitHub: search repos/code/issues, read repos/issues/PRs/files, list notifications, create issues — via OAuth device flow or a token.

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Git: status, log, diff, file history, branches/tags, gated stage/commit, and remote clone/fetch/pull/push — pure-JS, no git binary.

plugins.name: sql
plugins.description: SQL: read-only query + schema introspection over Postgres & SQLite, with gated writes — named connections, pure-JS, no native deps.

plugins.name: http
plugins.description: HTTP/REST client: ad-hoc requests plus saved collections and environments, env secrets, host-allowlisted + SSRF-safe — pure Node built-ins.
